scope: Read-only retained NPZ/tree comparisons; no native analysis, resampling, decode, tests, or quality conclusions. Full arrays only for five designated cases; other cases hashes only.

norm_definitions.old_l2_norm: sqrt(sum(old_i**2)) over all retained scalar elements in group, accumulated in float64
norm_definitions.relative_l2: difference_l2_norm / old_l2_norm; null for zero denominator, no epsilon
norm_definitions.max_abs_diff_over_old_abs_peak: max(abs(new_i-old_i)) / max(abs(old_i)); null for zero denominator, no epsilon
norm_definitions.limits: Group aggregation can conceal localized change; noise_model mixes phase/amplitude/PSD fields. No perceptual weighting or quality interpretation.
